latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generation AI API — Generate Videos from Text Prompts:

- Generate 15-second AI videos from text prompts via a free API (100 credits, 7-day token).
- Accepts uploads in MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF formats up to 500MB; outputs videos in 30–90 seconds.
- Supports developer integration with clear API endpoints for session, upload, generation, credits, and export.
- Handles errors and authentication workflow automatically.
- Includes workflow tips, input matching, and format compatibility info for ease of use.
